paragraphs: Rav Shmuel bar Bar Chana. See the entry Rav Shmuel, son of Rabbah bar Bar Chana.[^1]

notes.text: The target adds Rabbah as Shmuel’s father. בב״ח is completed from the heading’s bar Bar Chana; it does not create another title or remove a generation. Both Rav titles are explicit, and Rabbah remains the supplied proper name.
